DCMTK 3.7.0 -- a SUBSET, copied VERBATIM, do not edit (code of others, as it came).

source : https://github.com/DCMTK/dcmtk (the official repository, by OFFIS), tag
         DCMTK-3.7.0 (annotated tag dd841c3a858dfb20cfa8574a2a54a33d032b0de4)
commit : ccfd10b84ff3c9a40b7b331698aedf06d421fc43  (2025-12-15T08:28:13+01:00)
         cloned 2026-10-13 with  git clone --depth 1 --branch DCMTK-3.7.0
         (dicom.offis.de puts a JavaScript proof-of-work in front of its
         downloads, so the tarball could not be fetched by script.)
copied : the top-level CMakeLists.txt, CMake/, config/, doxygen/, COPYRIGHT, CREDITS,
         CHANGES, FAQ, HISTORY (the install step copies them),
         README, VERSION, ANNOUNCE and the modules ofstd oflog dcmdata dcmimgle
         dcmimage dcmjpeg dcmjpls, each COMPLETE (their CMakeLists add apps/ and
         tests/). Left out: every other module -- oficonv (37 MB of charset
         tables: we do not read text attributes), the network, TLS, SR, RT ...
licence: BSD-style (COPYRIGHT), with the IJG (libijg*) and CharLS (dcmjpls/
         libcharls) notices inside.

Used by cpp/ to decode the pixel data of <dicom> blocks. Configured with
DCMTK_MODULES restricted to the seven above, DCMTK_DEFAULT_DICT=builtin (no
dictionary file at run time), static, /MD -- see cpp/build_dcmtk.bat.
